description: Space Mission Design Game is an educational and entertaining game where players design rockets, plan space missions, and explore planets. Players can complete missions, earn rewards, unlock achievements, and improve their rocket designs.
summary: The Space Mission Design Game is an interactive educational simulation—featured in initiatives like the NASA Space Apps Challenge—that challenges players to plan, build, and operate a complete spacecraft or space exploration mission.
